column3: The closing ceremony is over... That marks the end of a long semester.
Studying for the exam is going well, so if I want to, I can fool around as much as I want.
...Though I don't actually have any plans.
I guess that's a good sign.
An angel has descended to this boring world.
You look quite happy. Did something good happen?
What are you saying? I'm just happy I got to meet you.
Geez... Mocking me again. I'm going to get angry.
Oh, that reaction wasn't as bad as expected.
Or maybe I'm just in a good mood today.
I have work, so I'll excuse myself.
I guess reality ain't that nice.
Good luck with work. I'll be cheering you on.
Does she need to go to the toilet or something?
